rows.description: When an attack roll against you would succeed, you can **mark a Stress** and roll a **d4.** Add the result to your Evasion against this attack.

rows.name: Fragile
rows.description: When you take Major or greater damage, you drop out of Beastform.

rows.name: Hobbling Strike
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make the target temporarily _Vulnerable_.

rows.name: Pack Hunting
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack against the same target as an ally who acts immediately before you, add a **d8** to your damage roll.

rows.name: Fleet
rows.description: **Spend a Hope** to move up to Far range without rolling.

rows.name: Takedown
rows.description: **Mark a Stress** to move into Melee range of a target and make an attack roll against them. On a success, you gain a +2 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack and the target must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Rampage
rows.description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, you can roll a **d10** and add the result to the damage roll. Additionally, before you make an attack roll, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for that attack.

rows.name: Thick Hide
rows.description: You gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Venomous Bite
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, the target becomes temporarily _Poisoned_. A _Poisoned_ creature takes **1d10** direct physical damage each time they act.

rows.name: Webslinger
rows.description: You can create a strong web material useful for both adventuring and battle. The web is resilient enough to support one creature. You can temporarily _Restrain_ a target within Close range by succeeding on a Finesse Roll against them.

rows.name: Venomous Strike
rows.description: Make an attack against any number of targets within Very Close range. On a success, a target is temporarily _Poisoned_. A _Poisoned_ creature takes **1d10** direct physical damage each time they act.

rows.name: Warning Hiss
rows.description: **Mark a Stress** to force any number of targets within Melee range to move back to Very Close range.

rows.name: Devastating Strikes
rows.description: When you deal Severe damage to a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to mark an additional Hit Point.

rows.name: Massive Stride
rows.description: You can move up to Far range without rolling. You ignore rough terain (at the GM's discretion) due to your size.

rows.name: Bird's-Eye View
rows.description: You can fly at will. Once per rest while you are airborne, you can ask the GM a question about the scene below you without needing to roll. The first time a character makes a roll to act on this information, they gain advantage on the roll.

rows.name: Hollow Bones
rows.description: You gain a -2 penalty to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Make a Scene
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

rows.name: Rally
rows.description: Once per session, describe how you rally the party and give yourself and each of your allies a Rally Die. At level 1, your Rally Die is a d6. A PC can spend their Rally Die to roll it, adding the result to their action roll, reaction roll, damage roll, or to clear a number of Stress equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Rally Dice. At level 5, your Rally Die increases to a d8.

rows.name: Beastform
rows.description: Mark a Stress to magically transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list. You can drop out of this form at any time. While transformed, you can't use weapons or cast spells from domain cards, but you can still use other features or abilities you have access to. Spells you cast before you transform stay active and last for their normal duration, and you can talk and communicate as normal. Additionally, you gain the Beastform's features, add their Evasion bonus to your Evasion, and use the trait specified in their statistics for your attack. While you're in a Beastform, your armor becomes part of your body and you mark Armor Slots as usual; when you drop out of a Beastform, those marked Armor Slots remain marked. If you mark your last Hit Point, you automatically drop out of this form.

rows.name: Evolution
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to transform into a Beastform without marking a Stress. When you do, choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of that Beastform.

rows.name: Wildtouch
rows.description: You can perform harmless, subtle effects that involve nature—such as causing a flower to rapidly grow, summoning a slight gust of wind, or starting a campfire at will.

rows.name: Frontline Tank
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

rows.name: Unstoppable
rows.description:
Once per long rest, you can become Unstoppable. You gain an Unstoppable Die. At level 1, your Unstoppable Die is a d4. Place it on your character sheet in the space provided, starting with the 1 value facing up. After you make a damage roll that deals 1 or more Hit Points to a target, increase the Unstoppable Die value by one. When the die's value would exceed its maximum value or when the scene ends, remove the die and drop out of Unstoppable. At level 5, your Unstoppable Die increases to a d6.

While Unstoppable, you gain the following benefits:

- You reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold (Severe to Major, Major to Minor, Minor to None).
- You add the current value of the Unstoppable Die to your damage roll.
- You can't be Restrained or Vulnerable.

rows.name: Hold Them Off
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope when you succeed on an attack with a weapon to use that same roll against two additional adversaries within range of the attack.

rows.name: Ranger's Focus
rows.description:
Spend a Hope and make an attack against a target. On a success, deal your attack's normal damage and temporarily make the attack's target your Focus. Until this feature ends or you make a different creature your Focus, you gain the following benefits against your Focus:

- You know precisely what direction they are in.
- When you deal damage to them, they must mark a Stress.
- When you fail an attack against them, you can end your Ranger's Focus feature to reroll your Duality Dice.

rows.name: Cloaked
rows.description: Any time you would be Hidden, you are instead Cloaked. In addition to the benefits of the Hidden condition, while Cloaked you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. After you make an attack or end a move within line of sight of an adversary, you are no longer Cloaked.

rows.name: Rogue's Dodge
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you. Otherwise, this bonus lasts until your next rest.

rows.name: Sneak Attack
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack while Cloaked or while an ally is within Melee range of your target, add a number of d6s equal to your tier to your damage roll.

rows.name: Life Support
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

rows.name: Prayer Dice
rows.description: At the beginning of each session, roll a number of d4s equal to your subclass's Spellcast trait and place them on your character sheet in the space provided. These are your Prayer Dice. You can spend any number of Prayer Dice to aid yourself or an ally within Far range. You can use a spent die's value to reduce incoming damage, add to a roll's result after the roll is made, or gain Hope equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Prayer Dice.

rows.name: Arcane Sense
rows.description: You can sense the presence of magical people and objects within Close range.

rows.name: Channel Raw Power
rows.description:
Once per long rest, you can place a domain card from your loadout into your vault and choose to either:

- Gain Hope equal to the level of the card.
- Enhance a spell that deals damage, gaining a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice the level of the card.

rows.name: Minor Illusion
rows.description: Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, you create a minor visual illusion no larger than yourself within Close range. This illusion is convincing to anyone at Close range or farther.

rows.name: Volatile Magic
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to reroll any number of your damage dice on an attack that deals magic damage.

rows.name: Attack of Opportunity
rows.description:
If an adversary within Melee range attempts to leave that range, make a reaction roll using a trait of your choice against their Difficulty. Choose one effect on a success, or two if you critically succeed:

- They can't move from where they are.
- You deal damage to them equal to your primary weapon's damage.
- You move with them.

rows.name: Combat Training
rows.description: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

rows.name: No Mercy
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls until your next rest.

rows.name: Not This Time
rows.description: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.

rows.name: Prestidigitation
rows.description: You can perform harmless, subtle magical effects at will. For example, you can change an object's color, create a smell, light a candle, cause a tiny object to float, illuminate a room, or repair a small object.

rows.name: Strange Patterns
rows.description: Choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll that number on a Duality Die, gain a Hope or clear a Stress. You can change this number when you take a long rest.

rows.name: Privilege
rows.description: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

rows.name: Well-Read
rows.description: You have advantage on rolls that involve the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

rows.name: Dedicated
rows.description: Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you're embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

rows.name: Steady
rows.description: You have advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use your survival knowledge.

rows.name: Know the Tide
rows.description: You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, place a token on your community card. You can hold a number of tokens equal to your level. Before you make an action roll, you can spend any number of these tokens to gain a +1 bonus to the roll for each token spent. At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

rows.name: Scoundrel
rows.description: You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

rows.name: Low-Light Living
rows.description: When you're in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

rows.name: Nomadic Pack
rows.description: Add a Nomadic Pack to your inventory. Once per session, you can **spend a Hope** to reach into this pack and pull out a mundane item that's useful to your situation. Work with the GM to figure out what item you take out.

rows.name: Lightfoot
rows.description: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.

rows.name: Acidpaste
rows.description: This paste eats away walls and other surfaces in bright flashes.

rows.name: Armor Stitcher
rows.description: You can use this stitcher to spend any number of Hope and clear that many Armor Slots.

rows.name: Attune Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Instinct Roll.

rows.name: Blinding Orb
rows.description: You can activate this orb to create a flash of bright light. All targets within Close range become Vulnerable until they mark HP.

rows.name: Blood of the Yorgi
rows.description: You can drink this blood to disappear from where you are and immediately reappear at a point you can see within Very Far range.

rows.name: Bolster Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Strength Roll.

rows.name: Bonding Honey
rows.description: This honey can be used to glue two objects together permanently.

rows.name: Bridge Seed
rows.description: Thick vines grow from your location to a point of your choice within Far range, allowing you to climb up or across them. The vines dissipate on your next rest.

rows.name: Channelstone
rows.description: You can use this stone to take a spell or grimoire from your vault, use it once, and return it to your vault.

rows.name: Charm Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Presence Roll.

rows.name: Circle of the Void
rows.description: Mark a Stress to create a void that extends up to Far range. No magic can be cast inside the void, and creatures within the void are immune to magic damage.

rows.name: Control Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Finesse Roll.

rows.name: Death Tea
rows.description: After you drink this tea, you instantly kill your target when you critically succeed on an attack. If you don't critically succeed on an attack before your next long rest, you die.

rows.name: Dragonbloom Tea
rows.description: You can drink this tea to unleash a fiery breath attack. Make an Instinct Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Targets you succeed against take 2d20 physical damage using your Proficiency.

rows.name: Dripfang Poison
rows.description: A creature who consumes this poison takes 8d10 direct magic damage.

rows.name: Enlighten Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Knowledge Roll.

rows.name: Feast of Xuria
rows.description: You can eat this meal to clear all HP and Stress and gain 1d4 Hope.

rows.name: Featherbone
rows.description: You can use this bone to control your falling speed for a number of minutes equal to your level.

rows.name: Gill Salve
rows.description: You can apply this salve to your neck to breathe underwater for a number of minutes equal to your level.

rows.name: Grindletooth Venom
rows.description: You can apply this venom to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d6 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

rows.name: Growing Potion
rows.description: You can drink this potion to double your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Strength and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

rows.name: Health Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4+1 HP.

rows.name: Homet's Secret Potion
rows.description: After drinking this potion, the next successful attack you make critically succeeds.

rows.name: Hopehold Flare
rows.description: When you use this flare, allies within Close range roll a d6 when they spend a Hope. On a result of 6, they gain the effect of that Hope without spending it. The flare lasts until the end of the scene.

rows.name: Improved Arcane Shard
rows.description: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 2d20 magic damage.

rows.name: Improved Grindletooth Venom
rows.description: You can apply this venom to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d8 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

rows.name: Jar of Lost Voices
rows.description: You can open this jar to release a deafening echo of voices for a number of minutes equal to your Instinct. Creatures within Far range unprepared for the sound take 6d8 magic damage.

rows.name: Jumping Root
rows.description: Eat this root to leap up to Far range once without needing to roll.

rows.name: Knowledge Stone
rows.description: If you die while holding this stone, an ally can take a card from your loadout to place in their loadout or vault. After they take this knowledge, the stone crumbles.

rows.name: Major Arcane Shard
rows.description: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 4d20 magic damage.

rows.name: Major Attune Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct until your next rest.

rows.name: Major Bolster Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength until your next rest.

rows.name: Major Charm Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence until your next rest.

rows.name: Major Control Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse until your next rest.

rows.name: Major Enlighten Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge until your next rest.

rows.name: Major Health Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4+2 HP.

rows.name: Major Stamina Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4+2 Stress.

rows.name: Major Stride Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility until your next rest.

rows.name: Minor Health Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4 HP.

rows.name: Minor Stamina Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4 Stress.

rows.name: Mirror of Marigold
rows.description: When you take damage, you can spend a Hope to negate that damage, after which the mirror shatters.

rows.name: Morphing Clay
rows.description: You can spend a Hope to use this clay, altering your face enough to make you unrecognizable until your next rest.

rows.name: Mythic Dust
rows.description: You can apply this dust to a weapon that deals magic damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

rows.name: Ogre Musk
rows.description: You can use this musk to prevent anyone from tracking you by mundane or magical means until your next rest.

rows.name: Potion of Stability
rows.description: You can drink this potion to choose one additional downtime move.

rows.name: Redthorn Saliva
rows.description: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

rows.name: Replication Parchment
rows.description: By touching this piece of parchment to another, you can perfectly copy the second parchment's contents. Once used, this parchment becomes mundane paper.

rows.name: Shrinking Potion
rows.description: You can drink this potion to halve your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Agility and a -1 penalty to your Proficiency.

rows.name: Sleeping Sap
rows.description: You can drink this potion to fall asleep for a full night's rest. You clear all Stress upon waking.

rows.name: Snap Powder
rows.description: Mark a Stress and clear a HP.

rows.name: Stamina Potion
rows.description: Clear 1d4+1 Stress.

rows.name: Stardrop
rows.description: You can use this stardrop to summon a hailstorm of comets that deals 8d20 physical damage to all targets within Very Far range.

rows.name: Stride Potion
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Agility Roll.

rows.name: Sun Tree Sap
rows.description: Consume this sap to roll a d6. On a result of 5-6, clear 2 HP. On a result of 2-4, clear 3 Stress. On a result of 1, see through the veil of death and return changed, gaining one scar.

rows.name: Sweet Moss
rows.description: You can consume this moss during a rest to clear 1d10 HP or 1d10 Stress.

rows.name: Unstable Arcane Shard
rows.description: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 1d20 magic damage.

rows.name: Varik Leaves
rows.description: You can eat these paired leaves to immediately gain 2 Hope.

rows.name: Vial of Darksmoke
rows.description: When an adversary attacks you, use this vial and roll a number of d6s equal to your Agility. Add the highest result to your Evasion against the attack.

rows.name: Vial of Moondrip
rows.description: When you drink the contents of this vial, you can see in total darkness until your next rest.

rows.name: Wingsprout
rows.description: You gain magic wings that allow you to fly for a number of minutes equal to your level.

rows.name: Airblade Charm
rows.description: You can attach this charm to a weapon with a Melee range. Three times per rest, you can activate the charm and attack a target within Close range.

rows.name: Alistair's Torch
rows.description: You can light this magic torch at will. The flame's light fills a much larger space than it should, enough to illuminate a cave bright as day.

rows.name: Arcane Cloak
rows.description: A creature with a Spellcast trait wearing this cloak can adjust its color, texture, and size at will.

rows.name: Arcane Prism
rows.description: Position this prism in a location of your choosing and activate it. All allies within Close range of it gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls. While activated, the prism can't be moved. Once the prism is deactivated, it can't be activated again until your next long rest.

rows.name: Attune Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Bag of Ficklesand
rows.description: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful Presence Roll (10). Additionally, on a successful Finesse Roll (10), you can blow a bit of sand into a target's face to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

rows.name: Belt of Unity
rows.description: Once per session, you can spend 5 Hope to lead a Tag Team Roll with three PCs instead of two.

rows.name: Bloodstone
rows.description: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

rows.name: Bolster Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Box of Many Goods
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can open this small box and roll a d12. On a result of 1-6, it’s empty. On a result of 7-10, it contains one random common consumable. On a result of 11-12, it contains two random common consumables.

rows.name: Calming Pendant
rows.description: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, don't mark it.

rows.name: Charging Quiver
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack with an arrow stored in this quiver, gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your current tier.

rows.name: Charm Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Clay Companion
rows.description: When you sculpt this ball of clay into a clay animal companion, it behaves as that animal. For example, a clay spider can spin clay webs, while a clay bird can fly. The clay companion retains memory and identity across different shapes, but they can adopt new mannerisms with each form.

rows.name: Companion Case
rows.description: This case can fit a small animal companion. While the companion is inside, the animal and case are immune to all damage and harmful effects.

rows.name: Control Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Corrector Sprite
rows.description: This tiny sprite sits in the curve of your ear canal and whispers helpful advice during combat. Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on an attack roll.

rows.name: Dual Flask
rows.description: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask’s side.

rows.name: Elusive Amulet
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this amulet to become Hidden until you move. While Hidden in this way, you remain unseen even if an adversary moves to where they would normally see you.

rows.name: Empty Chest
rows.description: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

rows.name: Enlighten Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Fire Jar
rows.description: You can pour out the strange liquid contents of this jar to instantly produce fire. The contents regenerate when you take a long rest.

rows.name: Flickerfly Pendant
rows.description: While you carry this pendant, your weapons with a Melee range that deal physical damage have a gossamer sheen and can attack targets within Very Close range.

rows.name: Gecko Gloves
rows.description: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

rows.name: Gem of Alacrity
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Agility when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Gem of Audacity
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Presence when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Gem of Insight
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Instinct when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Gem of Might
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Strength when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Gem of Precision
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Finesse when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Gem of Sagacity
rows.description: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Knowledge when making an attack with that weapon.

rows.name: Glamour Stone
rows.description: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

rows.name: Glider
rows.description: While falling, you can mark a Stress to deploy this small parachute and glide safely to the ground.

rows.name: Greatstone
rows.description: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

rows.name: Homing Compasses
rows.description: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

rows.name: Honing Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to an Experience of your choice. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Hopekeeper Locket
rows.description: During a long rest, if you have 6 Hope, you can spend a Hope to imbue this locket with your bountiful resolve. When you have 0 Hope, you can use the locket to immediately gain a Hope. The locket must be re‑imbued before it can be used this way again.

rows.name: Infinite Bag
rows.description: When you store items in this bag, they are kept in a pocket dimension that never runs out of space. You can retrieve an item at any time.

rows.name: Lakestrider Boots
rows.description: You can walk on the surface of water as if it were soft ground.

rows.name: Lorekeeper
rows.description: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain a +1 bonus to action rolls against those creatures.

rows.name: Manacles
rows.description: This pair of locking cuffs comes with a key.

rows.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe
rows.description: As a downtime move, you can use a vial of blood to craft a Minor Health Potion.

rows.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe
rows.description: As a downtime move, you can use the bone of a creature to craft a Minor Stamina Potion.

rows.name: Mythic Dust Recipe
rows.description: As a downtime move, you can use a handful of fine gold dust to craft Mythic Dust.

rows.name: Paragon's Chain
rows.description: As a downtime move, you can meditate on an ideal or principle you hold dear and focus your will into this chain. Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to roll a d20 as your Hope Die for rolls that directly align with that principle.

rows.name: Phoenix Feather
rows.description: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather on you when you fall unconscious, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll you make to determine whether you gain a scar.

rows.name: Piercing Arrows
rows.description: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

rows.name: Piper Whistle
rows.description: This handcrafted whistle has a distinctive sound. When you blow this whistle, its piercing tone can be heard within a 1-mile radius.

rows.name: Portal Seed
rows.description: You can plant this seed in the ground to grow a portal in that spot. The portal is ready to use in 24 hours. You can use this portal to travel to any other location where you planted a portal seed. A portal can be destroyed by dealing any amount of Magic damage to it.

rows.name: Premium Bedroll
rows.description: During downtime, you automatically clear a Stress.

rows.name: Ring of Resistance
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

rows.name: Ring of Silence
rows.description: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

rows.name: Ring of Unbreakable Resolve
rows.description: Once per session, when the GM spends a Fear, you can spend 4 Hope to cancel the effects of that spent Fear.

rows.name: Shard of Memory
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can spend 2 Hope to recall a domain card from your vault instead of paying its Recall Cost.

rows.name: Skeleton Key
rows.description: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

rows.name: Speaking Orbs
rows.description: This pair of orbs allows any creatures holding them to communicate with each other across any distance.

rows.name: Stride Relic
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility. You can only carry one relic.

rows.name: Suspended Rod
rows.description: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until the rod is deactivated, it can't move, doesn't abide by the rules of gravity, and remains in place.

rows.name: Valorstone
rows.description: You can attach this stone to armor that doesn't already have a feature. The armor gains the following feature. Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a result of 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

rows.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe
rows.description: As a downtime move, you can mark a Stress to craft a Vial of Darksmoke.

rows.name: Woven Net
rows.description: You can make a Finesse Roll using this net to trap a small creature. A trapped target can break free with a successful Attack Roll (16).

rows.name: Advanced Training
rows.description: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.

rows.name: Battle-Bonded
rows.description: When an adversary attacks you while they're within your companion's Melee range, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

rows.name: Companion
rows.description:
You have an animal companion of your choice (at the GM's discretion). They stay by your side unless you tell them otherwise.

Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.

rows.name: Expert Training
rows.description: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.

rows.name: Loyal Friend
rows.description: Once per long rest, when the damage from an attack would mark your companion's last Stress or your last Hit Point and you're within Close range of each other, you or your companion can rush to the other's side and take that damage instead.

rows.name: Battle Ritual
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can spend several minutes focusing your mind and body to clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

rows.name: Camaraderie
rows.description: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. Additionally, when an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you, they only need to spend 2 Hope to do so.

rows.name: Courage
rows.description: When you fail a roll, if your Fear die is higher than your Hope die, gain 1 Hope.

rows.name: Rise to the Challenge
rows.description: When you have 2 or fewer Hit Points remaining, when you make an action roll, you can roll a d20 as your Hope die instead of your usual Hope die.

rows.name: Martial Preparation
rows.description: You're an inspirational warrior to all who travel with you. Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation downtime move. To use this move during a rest, describe how you instruct and train with your party. You and each ally who chooses this downtime move gain a **d6** Slayer Die. A PC with a Slayer Die can spend it to roll the die and add the result to an attack or damage roll of their choice.

rows.name: Slayer
rows.description: You gain a pool of dice called Slayer Dice. On a roll with Hope, you can place a **d6** on this card instead of gaining a Hope, adding the die to the pool. You can store a number of Slayer Dice equal to your Proficiency. When you make an attack roll or damage roll, you can spend any number of these Slayer Dice, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session, clear any unspent Slayer Dice on this card and gain a Hope per die cleared.

rows.name: Weapon Specialist
rows.description: You can wield multiple weapons with dangerous ease. When you succeed on an attack, you can **spend a Hope** to add one of the damage dice from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Additionally, once per long rest when you roll your Slayer Dice, reroll any 1s.

rows.name: Devout
rows.description: When you roll your Prayer Dice, you can roll an additional die and discard the lowest result. Additionally, you can use your "Sparing Touch" feature twice instead of once per long rest.

rows.name: Sacred Resonance
rows.description: When you roll damage for your "Spirit Weapon" feature, if any of the die results match, double the value of each matching die. For example, if you roll two 5s, they count as two 10s.

rows.name: Sparing Touch
rows.description: Once per long rest, touch a creature and clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress from them.

rows.name: Spirit Weapon
rows.description: When you have an equipped weapon with a range of Melee or Very Close, it can fly from your hand to attack an adversary within Close range and then return to you. You can **mark a Stress** to target an additional adversary within range with the same attack roll.

rows.name: Elementalist
rows.description:
Choose one of the following elements at character creation: air, earth, fire, lightning, water.

You can shape this element into harmless effects. Additionally, **spend a Hope** and describe how your control over this element helps an action roll you're about to make, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll's damage.

rows.name: Natural Evasion
rows.description: You can call forth your element to protect you from harm. When an attack roll against you succeeds, you can **mark a Stress** and describe how you use your element to defend you. When you do, roll a **d6** and add its result to your Evasion against the attack.

rows.name: Transcendence
rows.description:
Once per long rest, you can transform into a physical manifestation of your element. When you do, describe your transformation and choose two of the following benefits to gain until your next rest:

- +4 bonus to your Severe threshold
- +1 bonus to a character trait of your choice
- +1 bonus to your Proficiency
- +2 bonus to your Evasion

rows.name: Adrenaline
rows.description: While you're Vulnerable, add your level to your damage rolls.

rows.name: Dark Cloud
rows.description: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, create a temporary dark cloud that covers any area within Close range. Anyone in this cloud can't see outside of it, and anyone outside of it can't see in. You're considered Cloaked from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.

rows.name: Fleeting Shadow
rows.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. You can use your "Shadow Stepper" feature to move within Very Far range.

rows.name: Shadow Stepper
rows.description: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object, you can mark a Stress to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within Far range. When you reappear, you are Cloaked.

rows.name: Vanishing Act
rows.description: Mark a Stress to become Cloaked at any time. When Cloaked from this feature, you automatically clear the Restrained condition if you have it. You remain Cloaked in this way until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

rows.name: Arcane Charge
rows.description: You can gather magical energy to enhance your capabilities. When you take magic damage, you become _Charged_. Alternatively, you can **spend 2 Hope** to become _Charged_. When you successfully make an attack that deals magic damage while _Charged_, you can clear your _Charge_ to either gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll or gain a +3 bonus to the Difficulty of a reaction roll the spell causes the target to make. You stop being _Charged_ at your next long rest.

rows.name: Enchanted Aid
rows.description: You can enhance the magic of others with your essence. When you Help an Ally with a Spellcast Roll, you can roll a **d8** as your advantage die. Once per long rest, after an ally has made a Spellcast Roll with your help, you can swap the results of their Duality Dice.

rows.name: Manipulate Magic
rows.description:
Your primal origin allows you to modify the essence of magic itself. After you cast a spell or make an attack using a weapon that deals magic damage, you can **mark a Stress** to do one of the following:

- Extend the spell or attack's reach by one range
- Gain a +2 bonus to the action roll's result
- Double a damage die of your choice
- Hit an additional target within range

rows.name: Accomplished
rows.description: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

rows.name: Adept
rows.description: When you Utilize an Experience, you can **mark a Stress** instead of spending a Hope. If you do, double your Experience modifier for that roll.

rows.name: Brilliant
rows.description: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

rows.name: Honed Expertise
rows.description: When you use an Experience, roll a **d6.** On a result of 5 or higher, you can use it without spending Hope.

rows.name: Perfect Recall
rows.description: Once per rest, when you recall a domain card in your vault, you can reduce its Recall Cost by 1.

rows.name: Prepared
rows.description: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

rows.name: Battlemage
rows.description: You've focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

rows.name: Conjure Shield
rows.description: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 Hope, you add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

rows.name: Face Your Fear
rows.description: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, you deal an extra **1d10** magic damage.

rows.name: Fueled by Fear
rows.description: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **2d10**.

rows.name: Have No Fear
rows.description: The extra magic damage from your "Face Your Fear" feature increases to **3d10.**

rows.name: Thrive in Chaos
rows.description: When you succeed on an attack, you can **mark a Stress** after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

rows.name: Iron Will
rows.description: When you take physical damage, you can mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity.

rows.name: Loyal Protector
rows.description: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points and would take damage, you can mark a Stress to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.

rows.name: Partners-in-Arms
rows.description: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can mark an Armor Slot to reduce the severity by one threshold.

rows.name: Undaunted
rows.description: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Unrelenting
rows.description: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Unwavering
rows.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Contacts Everywhere
rows.description:
Once per session, you can briefly call on a shady contact. Choose one of the following benefits and describe what brought them here to help you in this moment:

- They provide 1 handful of gold, a unique tool, or a mundane object that the situation requires.
- On your next action roll, their help provides a +3 bonus to the result of your Hope or Fear Die.
- The next time you deal damage, they snipe from the shadows, adding **2d8** to your damage roll.

rows.name: Reliable Backup
rows.description:
You can use your "Contacts Everywhere" feature three times per session. The following options are added to the list of benefits you can choose from when you use that feature:

- When you mark 1 or more Hit Points, they can rush out to shield you, reducing the Hit Points marked by 1.
- When you make a Presence Roll in conversation, they back you up. You can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

rows.name: Well-Connected
rows.description:
When you arrive in a prominent town or environment, you know somebody who calls this place home. Give them a name, note how you think they could be useful, and choose one fact from the following list:

- They owe me a favor, but they'll be hard to find.
- They're going to ask for something in exchange.
- They're always in a great deal of trouble.
- We used to be together. It's a long story.
- We didn't part on great terms.

rows.name: Gifted Performer
rows.description:
You can play three different types of songs, once each per long rest; describe how you perform for others to gain the listed benefit:

- Relaxing Song: You and all allies within Close range clear a Hit Point.
- Epic Song: Make a target within Close range temporarily Vulnerable.
- Heartbreaking Song: You and all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

rows.name: Maestro
rows.description: Your rallying songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

rows.name: Virtuoso
rows.description: You are among the greatest of your craft and your skill is boundless. You can perform each of your “Gifted Performer” feature’s songs twice per long rest (instead of once).

rows.name: Act of Reprisal
rows.description: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the next successful attack you make against that adversary.

rows.name: At Ease
rows.description: Gain an additional Stress slot.

rows.name: Nemesis
rows.description: Spend 2 Hope to Prioritize an adversary until your next rest. When you make an attack against your Prioritized adversary, you can swap the results of your Hope and Fear Dice. You can only Prioritize one adversary at a time.

rows.name: Revenge
rows.description: When an adversary within Melee range succeeds on an attack against you, you can mark 2 Stress to force the attacker to mark a Hit Point.

rows.name: Clarity of Nature
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can create a space of natural serenity within Close range. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

rows.name: Defender
rows.description: When you're in Beastform and an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.

rows.name: Regeneration
rows.description: Touch a creature and spend 3 Hope. That creature clears 1d4 Hit Points.

rows.name: Regenerative Reach
rows.description: You can target creatures within Very Close range with your "Regeneration" feature.

rows.name: Warden's Protection
rows.description: Once per long rest, spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on 1d4 allies within Close range.

rows.name: Elemental Aura
rows.description:
Once per rest while Channeling, you can assume an aura matching your element. The aura affects targets within Close range until your Channeling ends.

- Fire: When an adversary marks 1 or more Hit Points, they must also mark a Stress.
- Earth: Your allies gain a +1 bonus to Strength.
- Water: When an adversary deals damage to you, you can mark a Stress to move them anywhere within Very Close range of where they are.
- Air: When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond Melee range, reduce the damage by 1d8.

rows.name: Elemental Dominion
rows.description:
You further embody your element. While Channeling, you gain the following benefit:

- Fire: You gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage.
- Earth: When you would mark Hit Points, roll a d6 per Hit Point marked. For each result of 6, reduce the number of Hit Points you mark by 1.
- Water: When an attack against you succeeds, you can mark a Stress to make the attacker temporarily Vulnerable.
- Air: You gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and can fly.

rows.name: Elemental Incarnation
rows.description:
Mark a Stress to Channel one of the following elements until you take Severe damage or until your next rest:

- Fire: When an adversary within Melee range deals damage to you, they take 1d10 magic damage.
- Earth: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.
- Water: When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range, all other adversaries within Very Close range must mark a Stress.
- Air: You can hover, gaining advantage on Agility Rolls.

rows.name: Apex Predator
rows.description: Before you make an attack roll against your Focus, you can spend a Hope. On a successful attack, you remove a Fear from the GM Fear pool.

rows.name: Elusive Predator
rows.description: When your Focus makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

rows.name: Path Forward
rows.description: When you're traveling to a place you've previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

rows.name: Ruthless Predator
rows.description: When you make a damage roll, you can mark a Stress to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Additionally, when you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Ascendant
rows.description: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

rows.name: Ethereal Visage
rows.description: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

rows.name: Power of the Gods
rows.description: While flying, you deal an extra 1d12 damage instead of 1d8 from your "Wings of Light" feature.

rows.name: Wings of Light
rows.description:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:

- Mark a Stress to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
- Spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

rows.name: Eloquent
rows.description:
Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following:

- Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need.
- Help an Ally without spending Hope.
- Give them an additional downtime move during their next rest.

rows.name: Epic Poetry
rows.description: Your Rally Die increases to a d10. Additionally, when you Help an Ally, you can narrate the moment as if you were writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a d10 as your advantage die.

rows.name: Heart of a Poet
rows.description: After you make an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can spend a Hope to add a d4 to the roll.

rows.name: Rousing Speech
rows.description: Once per long rest, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

rows.name: Barrier
rows.description: +X to Armor Score; -1 to Evasion (X = weapon tier + 1)

rows.name: Bonded
rows.description: Gain a bonus to your damage rolls equal to your level.

rows.name: Bouncing
rows.description: Mark 1 or more Stress to hit that many targets in range of the attack.

rows.name: Brave
rows.description: -1 to Evasion; +3 to Severe damage threshold

rows.name: Brutal
rows.description: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

rows.name: Burning
rows.description: When you roll a 6 on a damage die, the target must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Charged
rows.description: Mark a Stress to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency on a primary weapon attack.

rows.name: Concussive
rows.description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Hope to knock the target back to Far range.

rows.name: Cumbersome
rows.description: -1 to Finesse

rows.name: Deadly
rows.description: When you deal Severe damage, the target must mark an additional HP.

rows.name: Deflecting
rows.description: When you are attacked, you can mark an Armor Slot to gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to your available Armor Score against the attack.

rows.name: Destructive
rows.description: -1 to Agility; on a successful attack, all adversaries within Very Close range must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Devastating
rows.description: Before you make an attack roll, you can mark a Stress to use a d20 as your damage die.

rows.name: Double Duty
rows.description: +1 to Armor Score; +1 to primary weapon damage within Melee range.

rows.name: Doubled Up
rows.description: When you attack with your primary weapon, you can deal damage to another target within Melee range.

rows.name: Dueling
rows.description: When there are no other creatures within Close range of the target, gain advantage on your attack roll against them.

rows.name: Eruptive
rows.description: On a successful attack against a target within Melee range, all other adversaries within Very Close range must succeed on a reaction roll (14) or take half damage.

rows.name: Grappling
rows.description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Hope to Restrain the target or pull them into Melee range with you.

rows.name: Greedy
rows.description: Spend a handful of gold to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency on a damage roll.

rows.name: Healing
rows.description: During downtime, automatically clear a Hit Point.

rows.name: Heavy
rows.description: -1 to Evasion

rows.name: Hooked
rows.description: On a successful attack, you can pull the target into Melee range.

rows.name: Hot
rows.description: This weapon cuts through solid material.

rows.name: Invigorating
rows.description: On a successful attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, clear a Stress.

rows.name: Lifestealing
rows.description: On a successful attack, roll a d6. On a result of 6, clear a Hit Point or clear a Stress.

rows.name: Locked On
rows.description: On a successful attack, your next attack against the same target with your primary weapon automatically succeeds.

rows.name: Long
rows.description: This weapon's attack targets all adversaries in a line within range.

rows.name: Lucky
rows.description: On a failed attack, you can mark a Stress to reroll your attack.

rows.name: Massive
rows.description: -1 to Evasion; on a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

rows.name: Otherworldly
rows.description: On a successful attack, you can deal physical or magic damage.

rows.name: Painful
rows.description: Each time you make a successful attack, you must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Paired
rows.description: +X to primary weapon damage to targets within Melee range (X = paired weapon tier + 1).

rows.name: Parry
rows.description: When you are attacked, roll this weapon's damage dice. If any of the attacker's damage dice rolled the same value as your dice, the matching results are discarded from the attacker's damage dice before the damage you take is totaled.

rows.name: Persuasive
rows.description: Before you make a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to gain a +2 bonus to the result.

rows.name: Pompous
rows.description: You must have a Presence of 0 or lower to use this weapon.

rows.name: Powerful
rows.description: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

rows.name: Protective
rows.description: +1 to Armor Score

rows.name: Quick
rows.description: When you make an attack, you can mark a Stress to target another creature within range.

rows.name: Reliable
rows.description: +1 to attack rolls

rows.name: Reloading
rows.description: After you make an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 1, you must mark a Stress to reload this weapon before you can fire it again.

rows.name: Retractable
rows.description: The blade can be hidden in the hilt to avoid detection.

rows.name: Returning
rows.description: When this weapon is thrown within its range, it appears in your hand immediately after the attack.

rows.name: Scary
rows.description: On a successful attack, the target must mark a Stress.

rows.name: Self-Correcting
rows.description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, it deals 6 damage instead.

rows.name: Serrated
rows.description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, it deals 8 damage instead.

rows.name: Sharpwing
rows.description: Gain a bonus to your damage rolls equal to your Agility.

rows.name: Sheltering
rows.description: When you mark an Armor Slot, it reduces damage for you and all allies within Melee range of you who took the same damage.

rows.name: Startling
rows.description: Mark a Stress to crack the whip and force all adversaries within Melee range back to Close range.

rows.name: Timebending
rows.description: You choose the target of your attack after making your attack roll.

rows.name: Versatile
rows.description: This weapon can also be used with alternate statistics (trait, range, and damage as given on the weapon’s SRD entry).
